name: Gamma
desc: Turns a prompt into a designed deck, doc, or webpage.
desc_zh: 把一句话变成排好版的演示文稿、文档或网页。
solves: A blank slide deck is just a blank page. Gamma turns one sentence into a laid-out deck you can then edit.
solves_zh: 空白幻灯片就是一张白纸。Gamma 把一句话变成排好版的 deck，之后你再改。
best_for: When you need a presentable deck today and the content is already in your head.
best_for_zh: 当你今天就要一份能拿出去的 deck，内容已经在你脑子里。
notes: The most-used AI presentation tool by a wide margin, and its card-based editor changed how people think about slides. 首次公开发布日期精度：month-only 来源：https://new.qq.com/rain/a/20250915A0244F00
